settings.text:
Most things we sell can be returned. A few cannot, and we say which on the product itself before you buy, never afterwards.

If you want to return a Buy Now purchase, start by emailing orders@caratforus.com. We will tell you whether the item qualifies, and if it does we will issue a return authorisation with the address and the deadline. Please do not send anything back before you have that — an unannounced parcel is one we cannot match to an order or insure.

Return shipping is arranged and paid by you, and must be tracked and insured for the full value. That is not us being difficult: an uninsured parcel that disappears leaves neither of us with a remedy.

The exact terms you agreed to are below.
